description: This file defines a generic validation pipeline behavior for MediatR requests using FluentValidation. It intercepts requests, validates them, and throws exceptions if validation fails.

classes.name: ValidationPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A MediatR pipeline behavior that performs validation on requests using injected validators before passing control to the next handler.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Validates the request using all available validators, throws a ValidationException if any validation errors are found, otherwise proceeds with the request handling.
